title: Spaceflight Academy
name: Spaceflight Academy
tagline: Listen. Think. Fly the gates. Build for orbit.
description: A full 3D space academy for ages 5–12: walk the Spaceport, fly 3D Space Rush learning gates where every question and all three answers are read aloud before the timer, engineer real-physics rockets from blueprints, launch, and finish each mission with an orbit, docking, landing, sample or photo challenge. Includes a live Solar System observatory and the Classic 2D edition at /classic/.
